features.summary: Sort the complete filtered local Conversation index by recent activity, verified source size, or visible message count without rescanning Agent history.

contract.anchor: Conversation sorting is also an index query applied after filtering and before pagination.

states.idle: Recent or Best match keeps the existing local index order and selection.
states.working: The initiating sort field reloads one bounded page from the index while stale requests are ignored.
states.success: The list shows the complete filtered index in the requested deterministic order before pagination.
states.error: The existing Conversation feedback surface reports the index read failure without mutating source history.
states.cancelled: A superseded sort request cannot replace the result of a newer search, filter, or sort.
states.noOp: Selecting the current sort leaves the read-only index and Agent history unchanged.
states.stale: A newer list request wins; a later background refresh may update derived sizes and ordering normally.
states.partial: Records without a verified source size remain available after known-size records and never appear as zero.
states.persisted: Only the disposable device-local index stores derived source sizes; navigation retains the sort in memory.
states.rollback: Sorting performs no source or application-data mutation that requires recovery.

features.summary: Give Profiles and Workspaces the full work surface while preserving searchable object switching, creation, context actions, and dirty navigation protection in a temporary Page Header switcher.

contract.anchor: Profiles and Workspaces instead show one selected object

states.idle: The selected Profile or Workspace owns the full framed work surface and the switcher trigger identifies the current object.
states.working: Profile loading, Workspace inspection, and initiating actions keep stable object geometry and report progress in their existing scoped controls.
states.success: Choosing another object closes the switcher and renders that object without adding a persistent navigation column.
states.error: Broken Profiles and unavailable Workspace references remain selectable and expose their existing repair or removal paths.
states.cancelled: Escape or outside dismissal closes the switcher, clears its transient query, and leaves the current object unchanged.
states.noOp: Choosing the current object closes the switcher without reloading, mutating, or reordering it.
states.stale: Profile dirty-state guards and Workspace refresh semantics remain authoritative when selection races with newer state.
states.partial: Loading or broken object metadata is named in the switcher without replacing the stable work surface with a false empty state.
states.persisted: Object choice follows existing Profile and Workspace state; open state and search queries remain session-only UI state.
states.rollback: The layout performs no filesystem mutation; cancelled selection restores focus and existing Profile mutation recovery remains unchanged.

features.summary: Keep device-local Workspace references, inspect and edit real project-owned Agent files, and open the selected Agent in that directory without binding or applying a Profile.

states.idle: Workspaces lists device-local directory references and reads selected project-owned resources only on demand.
states.working: The initiating add, inspect, edit, preview, or open control reports local progress without blocking sibling workspaces.
states.success: The reference, verified Workspace file mutation, loaded-resource detail, or Agent launch is visible beside the affected Workspace.
states.error: The scoped command names its path and diagnostic reference while preserving the prior reference and project bytes.
states.cancelled: A cancelled picker, preview, editor, or launch preparation changes no reference, Profile, Agent, or project file.
states.noOp: Unchanged text and an already-copied identical Skill perform no write and create no backup.
states.stale: A Workspace file changed after review requires a refreshed diff before mutation.
states.partial: Unsupported, unreadable, or precedence-unknown Agent sources are named and loaded-resource details stay Partial.
states.persisted: Only Workspace reference metadata and verified recovery receipts persist in device-local AgentEnv data.
states.rollback: A Workspace mutation backup restores exact original bytes or prior absence; removing a reference never requires rollback because it never touches the directory.

features.summary: Publish ad-hoc direct macOS assets and separate stable-identity Homebrew assets, then update Cask installations through exact checksums.

states.idle: Settings shows the install channel and current version without blocking startup.
states.working: Check, download, and install report their own progress.
states.success: The stable official Release is current or a Homebrew update is ready or installed.
states.error: A copyable non-blocking failure remains in Settings with Retry.
states.cancelled: No background update process starts without a verified available release.
states.noOp: Equal and older versions are reported as up to date.
states.stale: A release asset that does not match the exact tag, architecture, URL, and SHA-256 is rejected.
states.partial: Direct installations may check but cannot install automatically.
states.persisted: Update preferences persist in device-local Settings.
states.rollback: Homebrew remains the installer and AgentEnv data is outside the application bundle.

features.summary: Send at most one allowlisted daily startup event from official builds unless the user opts out.

states.idle: Reporting is on by default in configured official builds and the exact payload can be previewed.
states.working: The request runs asynchronously with a short timeout.
states.success: One daily allowlisted startup event is recorded locally as sent.
states.error: Failures are discarded without delaying or failing the app.
states.cancelled: Disabling the setting prevents future requests and remains disabled after restart.
states.noOp: No compiled project token, an explicit opt-out, or an already-sent date performs no request.
states.stale: The payload is rebuilt from current bounded runtime facts.
states.partial: No partial payload or arbitrary extension fields are accepted.
states.persisted: A random installation ID and the last successful local event date are stored locally.
states.rollback: An explicit opt-out is preserved when older settings are migrated; deleting only the daily receipt never changes the preference.

features.summary: Compare the active Agent setup with a saved Profile in two isolated runs before Apply.

states.idle: Compare is available only for a saved Profile with an implemented Agent capability.
states.working: The initiating command and dialog report preparation and both isolated runs.
states.success: The result distinguishes Agent now from With Profile and persists one bounded report.
states.error: Failure identifies the affected run and preserves the real Agent and selected Workspace.
states.cancelled: Cancellation stops the child process and removes temporary homes and workspaces.
states.noOp: A Profile that matches the active Agent does not offer a redundant comparison run.
states.stale: A changed Agent or selected folder invalidates the result without writing either source.
states.partial: Excluded resources are visible and the result is labelled incomplete.
states.persisted: Only the latest redacted bounded report is stored in device-local data.
states.rollback: Temporary resources are removed and no real Agent or Workspace mutation requires recovery.

features.summary: Review a linked Skill collection, prepare every affected Agent, and move only the outer shared link.

contract.anchor: A Skill collection link is one physical migration boundary.

states.idle: The outer collection is summarized as one review boundary with member progress.
states.working: Per-member or batch decisions expose local progress without dismissing the parent review.
states.success: Exact collection intent is saved and deployed without applying unrelated Profile changes, then only the reviewed outer link is moved.
states.error: The failing member or Agent remains visible in the collection dialog and completed review decisions are retained safely.
states.cancelled: Closing review before migration performs no filesystem mutation.
states.noOp: A saved active Profile may remain globally pending; unrelated changes are neither required nor applied.
states.stale: Changed collection content, active Profile identity, or Profile content receipts require a fresh in-dialog review before mutation.
states.partial: Incomplete member decisions or an unsaved affected Profile stay in the parent dialog with the next executable action.
states.persisted: Member version decisions and path ownership boundaries are stored independently.
states.rollback: A verified backup restores the outer link and every affected Agent destination after failure.

features.summary: Recover from uncaught Renderer failures and give large orchestration modules explicit internal owners without changing normal product behavior or persisted effects.

states.idle: Normal workflows retain their existing commands, layout, IPC contracts, and persisted effects.
states.working: Extracted controllers and registrars preserve operation-local progress and the existing central mutation and diagnostic wrappers.
states.success: Normal results are unchanged; an uncaught render failure instead exposes Reload, Export diagnostics, and Quit.
states.error: Domain errors keep their existing scoped feedback while an uncaught render error is recorded and replaces only the failed Renderer tree.
states.cancelled: Existing cancellation and temporary-resource cleanup remain owned by the original workflow.
states.noOp: Equivalent inputs retain the existing semantic no-op and create no new write, Backup, or history entry.
states.stale: Existing request identity, preview freshness, and Target drift checks remain authoritative after extraction.
states.partial: Internal extraction can ship by bounded owner while the unchanged facade continues to support every existing caller.
states.persisted: No persistence schema changes; controllers hold transient UI state and service facades remain the source of truth.
states.rollback: Existing Backup and compensating recovery paths are unchanged; the Renderer fallback itself performs no product mutation.
